import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static long mod_pow(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        long p = scanner.nextLong();
        long k = scanner.nextLong();
        
        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(mod_pow(p, p - 1));
            return;
        }
        
        if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(mod_pow(p, p));
            return;
        }
        
        long order = 1;
        long current = k % p;
        while (current != 1) {
            current = (current * k) % p;
            ++order;
        }
        
        System.out.println(mod_pow(p, (p - 1) / order));
    }
}
